thread:
Ravi Patel: Noticed gaps in decrypt audit logs for a private on-prem customer (tenant-88). KMS handshake errors in keystore-agent logs around 2026-04-02T14:10Z. SIEM produced a discrepancy alert.
OpsBot: ALERT 1780001234 - audit-integrity-gap - severity=high - resource=priv-cluster-88 - rule=audits.missing_decrypt_entries
Nisha Rao: Which change went out this morning? any RBAC or netpol updates?
Ravi Patel: We pushed two things at 13:58Z: PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/ops/changes/2612 commit b4c2d9e - reduced svcacc principal scoping to "node:agent" and PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/network/changes/584 commit a7e1f33 - tightened netpol egress for private clusters.
Diego Lopez: Tightened netpol egress could block KMS control-plane endpoints. Keystore-agent falls back if it can't reach routing API, then uses local routing cache -> stale routes -> wrong key_id or unable to fetch key metadata which can cause audit generator to emit redacted payloads.
Ravi Patel: Sample logs attached in thread: ```2026-04-02T14:09:58Z keystore-agent[agent] WARN handshake failed: dial tcp 10.12.5.90:443: i/o timeout; using fallback cache; route=rdw-miss```
Nisha Rao: Also saw agent crash loops on one node. Vulnerability scanner flagged the agent image v1.4.2 with CVE-2026-1010 that can cause TLS handshake regressions under load. That could explain intermittent reconnects. Rolling image pinned to v1.4.1 would be quick mitigation.
Diego Lopez: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) relax netpol to allow egress to KMS control IPs (apply patch below), 2) pin keystore-agent image to v1.4.1 and restart, 3) revert the svcacc scoping change for keystore-agent until we validate scrub rules. Patch command: ```kubectl -n private-egress patch networkpolicy allow-kms-egress -p '{"spec":{"egress":[{"to":[{"ipBlock":{"cidr":"10.12.5.88/30"}}],"ports":[{"port":443,"protocol":"TCP"}]}]}}'```
Ravi Patel: Applied netpol relax at 14:25Z and pinned image at 14:31Z. After restart agent logs show successful handshake: "INFO handshake successful, fetched route table v=2026-04-02-1400". Found ~1.2h window with empty payloads in audit buffer. Starting reingest job replay-priv88-20260402.
Nisha Rao: Forensics checklist: - collect keystore-agent pod logs and node system logs for window 13:45-15:00Z; - preserve raw audit buffers (S3 path: s3://secure-buffers/priv88/raw/2026-04-02/); - export KMS control-plane audit for route changes and key rotations; - run policy test harness against svcacc change before reapplying.
ComplianceBot: Incident INC-2026-43 created - priority=P1 - notify #legal #compliance #customers - retention=14d. Please include a high-level impact summary for the customer by EOD.
Diego Lopez: Triage note re vulnerability: create CVE ticket and escalate to infra-sec to track required image rebuilds. Short-term we pin and schedule a canary for v1.4.3 once patched.
Ravi Patel: Assigning roles: Ravi incident lead, Nisha forensic lead, Diego keystore/ops lead. I'll draft the blameless RCA in INC-2026-43 with timeline, impact, and mitigations. Thanks team.
